vision.BODY_FIT: LOADOUT BENCH / deeper embodied fit and readiness owner

loop: PLACE → STASH → PREP → FIT → SET OUT → RETURN → SERVICE → READY
implemented: BASE becomes the default unaddressed /house/ projection while #PLAN/#TRACE/#CARE and every explicit existing hash remain direct projections.
Fixed-locus tableau reuses the selected HOUSE room geometry and recovered anchors rather than inventing free-roaming 3D navigation.
Browser-local LOCAL KIT stores only user-authored exact references with home address, READY/SERVICE/UNKNOWN state and optional tags.
Temporary LOADOUT selection references LOCAL KIT items; it never clones canonical object state or claims physical possession.
Route/task frictions are explicit: carry / weather / power / install / mobility / duration / room-task.
SET OUT reuses atlas-dayline-handoff/v0.1 and carries purpose + exact HOUSE address + selected local refs + friction with an explicit planning-only truth boundary.
RETURN is explicit READY / SERVICE / UNKNOWN. SERVICE and UNKNOWN reuse canonical browser-local HOUSE CARE instead of creating another maintenance queue; READY creates no care residue.
ENV-0 scale ladder BODY → GARMENT → HARNESS → SUIT → FURNITURE → ROOM → HOUSE is visible as the coupling grammar, with direct ENV-0/BODY/FIT/Shopping/Foundry/Expert shortcuts.
Canonical /house/ remains the only human route; /house/spatial/ remains compatibility-only and HOUSEBUS authority is unchanged.
